title: Decision and Filing Clocks Written into the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plans
content:
The time the plan has to decide a drug coverage request, and the time a member has to bring a redetermination, are written into each Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan at the figures this timetable gives. Hours are hours and calendar days are calendar days; the two units are set out separately below because the plans use both.

| Plan | Standard coverage determination (hours) | Expedited coverage determination (hours) | Standard formulary or tiering exception (hours) | Expedited exception (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 72 | 24 | 72 | 24 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 72 | 24 | 72 | 24 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 72 | 24 | 72 | 24 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 72 | 24 | 72 | 24 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 72 | 24 | 72 | 24 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 48 | 24 | 48 | 24 |

| Plan | Standard plan-level redetermination (calendar days) | Expedited plan-level redetermination (hours) | Filing window after the adverse determination notice (calendar days) | Good-cause extension for a late filing (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 7 | 72 | 60 | 30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 7 | 72 | 60 | 30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 7 | 72 | 60 | 30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 7 | 72 | 60 | 30 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 7 | 72 | 60 | 45 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 5 | 72 | 60 | 45 |

## Notes on the two units

The expedited coverage determination and expedited exception clocks stand at 24 hours on every plan, and the expedited redetermination clock at 72 hours on every plan. Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) is the one plan written at 48 hours for a standard determination and a standard exception and at 5 calendar days for a standard redetermination; the other five stand at 72 hours and 7 calendar days. The filing window of 60 calendar days is the same on all six plans, while the good-cause extension is 30 calendar days on the four lower plans and 45 on Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) and Premier (PDP).
